mission.title: Merge 100 WPS Tables into Excel -- 2
mission.authorization_evidence: User explicitly approved taking the mission in ChatGPT conversation.
mission.payment_path: Freelancer milestone payment; payout method selected after award

scope.deliverable: One consolidated .xlsx workbook containing all rows from 100 WPS table files in one filterable and sortable worksheet.
acceptance_criteria: Every source table is processed and reconciled.
Differing headers are unioned without losing source information.
Missing values remain blank in columns absent from a source file.
Merged cells, stray line breaks and disruptive styles are removed.
The final worksheet is filterable and sortable.
A short reconciliation note documents header mapping and exceptions.
execution_method: Inspect a representative sample and identify the actual WPS file format.
Convert or read each file with a reproducible Python-based ingestion pipeline where technically supported.
Normalize headers while preserving all distinct fields.
Append all rows into a single tabular dataset.
Run row-count, source-file coverage, duplicate and blank-header checks.
Export and validate the final .xlsx workbook.

proposal.text: Hello, I can consolidate the 100 WPS table files into one clean Excel worksheet while preserving every distinct field. I will first inspect a representative sample to confirm the WPS format, then build a reproducible import and normalization process, union the differing headers, append all rows, remove merged cells and stray formatting, and validate source-file coverage and row counts before delivery. You will receive one filterable and sortable .xlsx file plus a short note describing header mappings and any exceptions. My proposed rate is USD 10/hour, with an initial estimate of up to 8 hours after the sample-format check. I can start immediately once the files are available.
